# Rishit Sinha

> Final-year Computer Science student and full-stack developer with a growing focus on backend engineering and AI. Currently working as a Shopify Developer on production storefronts, and building independent products.

Rishit ships full-stack products: Klryo (selected for Sentry's Open Source Program), Financcino, and Flux are live; ClarityCXR and OpenLink are in development. Stack: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, MySQL.

## Project case studies

- [Klryo](https://www.rishitsinha.online/work/klryo): Browser-based development environment — Monaco editor, multi-language execution via Judge0, AI assistance, real-time collaboration. Status: Live. Selected for Sentry's Open Source Program.
- [OpenLink](https://www.rishitsinha.online/work/openlink): Provider-agnostic AI API layer with adapters, response normalization, and schema validation. Status: In development.
- [Financcino](https://www.rishitsinha.online/work/financcino): Personal finance workspace — expenses, OCR receipt processing, budgets, analytics, and AI insights. Status: Live.
- [ClarityCXR](https://www.rishitsinha.online/work/ClarityCXR): Multimodal AI workspace for chest X-rays. Status: In development.
- [Flux](https://www.rishitsinha.online/work/flux): Real-time streaming platform — RTMP ingest, adaptive HLS playback, live chat. Status: Live.
